scripts.dev: echo npm run dev is not configured. Install a dev server or framework CLI and point this script at it. && exit 1
scripts.build: echo npm run build is not configured. Install a build tool and point this script at it. && exit 1
scripts.start: echo npm start is not configured. Point this script at the server that serves START_URL. && exit 1
scripts.preview: echo npm run preview is not configured. Point this script at a production-like local server if your stack has one. && exit 1
scripts.test: echo npm test is not configured. Install a test runner and point this script at it. && exit 1
scripts.test:watch: echo npm run test:watch is not configured. Point this script at your test runner watch mode. && exit 1
scripts.test:coverage: echo npm run test:coverage is not configured. Point this script at your test runner coverage run and have it write coverage/coverage-summary.json so the Betterer coverage ratchets can be re-enabled. && exit 1
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:styles && npm run test:coverage && npm run betterer:ci && npm run build
